title: AI Application Startup Lovable Completes $4 Billion C-Round Financing, Valuation Doubles to $13.3 Billion

content_html:
European "Vibe-Coding" startup Lovable officially announced on August 12 that it has completed a $400 million Series C financing round, with its valuation surging to $13.3 billion. The round was led by Menlo Ventures and Scaleup Europe Fund, with more than a dozen well-known investment institutions including Regent participating.

This valuation marks a doubling from its $6.6 billion valuation in December last year when it raised $330 million led by Menlo Ventures and CapitalG, indicating that AI-generated development tools are experiencing commercial breakthroughs and continued enthusiasm from the capital market.

As an AI-driven code generation and development platform, Lovable's explosive growth has directly accelerated its commercialization process. The company successfully achieved a $500 million annual recurring revenue (ARR) in June this year, and the number of projects hosted on its platform has now exceeded 60 million, attracting as many as 900 million monthly visitors.

In response to the increased backend computing power and complex architecture demands brought about by the rapid expansion of its business, Lovable offers mainstream advanced large models while also launching its independently developed AI model. In June this year, it signed a multi-year cooperation agreement with Google Cloud, leading to a fivefold increase in computing power usage. Additionally, Lovable is accelerating its local ecosystem building in Europe, strategically investing in Danish hardware design Vibe-coding startup Atech.

At a time when generative AI is reshaping software development paradigms, Lovable's rapid rise not only demonstrates the strong profitability potential of the AI code generation field, but also indicates that AI-assisted development is rapidly evolving from single-code completion to full-process autonomous construction.

content_html_zh:
欧洲“Vibe-Coding”初创公司Lovable于8月12日正式宣布完成4亿美元C轮融资，估值飙升至133亿美元。 本轮由Menlo Ventures和Scaleup Europe Fund领投，Regent等十几家知名投资机构参与。

这一估值较去年12月的66亿美元估值翻了一番，当时由Menlo Ventures和CapitalG领投的3.3亿美元融资，表明AI生成的开发工具正在经历商业突破和资本市场的持续热情。

作为AI驱动的代码生成和开发平台，Lovable的爆发式增长直接加速了其商业化进程。 该公司今年6月成功实现了5亿美元的年度经常性收入（ARR），其平台上托管的项目数量现已超过6000万个，每月吸引多达9亿的访问者。

针对业务快速扩张带来的后端算力提升和复杂架构需求，Lovable在提供主流先进大型模型的同时，也推出了自主研发的AI模型。 今年6月，它与谷歌云签署了多年合作协议，算力使用量增长了五倍。 此外，Lovable 正在加速其在欧洲的本地生态系统建设，战略投资丹麦硬件设计 Vibe-coding 初创公司 Atech。

在生成式AI正在重塑软件开发范式的当下，Lovable的快速崛起不仅展示了AI代码生成领域强大的盈利潜力，也预示着AI辅助开发正在从单代码完成向全流程自主构建快速演进。
